notes.subject: אי נקי
notes.rationale: 'not innocent' (YLT, ASV, BSB) vs 'island of the innocent' (KJV) vs 'him that is innocent' (JPS); אי can be 'island' or the negative 'not' — I take 'not innocent'.

notes.subject: וְנִמְלַט
notes.rationale: Passive 'he shall be delivered' vs active 'it (the island) shall be delivered'; subject ambiguity rides on the previous crux.

notes.subject: בבר כפיך
notes.rationale: Literally 'in the purity of your palms'; rendered 'ni i bolo tiɲɛ-ko ye' keeping hand and purity.

translation: A bɛna lasigi mɔgɔ min ma jurumu kɛ ⟨hali⟩, ani o bɛna lasigi ni i bolo tiɲɛ-ko ye.
